novedades.titulo: 車房結構健康自主監測極限 43/90 AUTONOMOUS STRUCTURAL HEALTH MONITORING OF MOBILE HABITATS AT THE LIMIT AUTONOMOUS STRUCTURAL HEALTH MONITORING OF MOBILE HABITATS AT THE LIMIT is a 777-page English Research Working Edition of the STARLI YULI Nano Supercar Trilogy (Research Institute XXXVI, Flagship 43 of 90). Its core coupling is Distributed Sensing x Fault Diagnosis x Predictive Maintenance. The book asks whether the physical health of a repeatedly moving and morphing modular habitat can be distinguished from normal changes in support, loading, geometry, temperature, humidity and measurement reference. The research setting is strictly scaled and unoccupied: instrumented panels, configurable hinges and locks, blind structural defects, environmental chambers and hardware-in-the-loop controllers. No habitable or road-certified mobile home is claimed. The falsifiable contract challenges a frozen diagnostic architecture against competent scheduled inspection, a calibrated classical modal detector and conventional condition-based maintenance under equal sensing, energy, time, human-operation and specimen budgets. It investigates damage-event recall, critical false release, detection timing, environmental normalization, sensor drift and physical-stop performance. The source Flagship 43 contract additionally specifies air-quality recovery without worsening false release; F43 preserves this as a separately tested environmental side constraint, not a substitute for structural load truth. Concealed challenges include fatigue cracks, loosened latches, sensor common-mode bias, unreported support changes, shifted water ballast, clock skew, missed communication packets, moisture leaks and hidden ventilation faults. An uncertain load path must result in an actual physical refusal, not a favourable aggregate health score. Thirty distinct mathematical research plates cover linearized structural dynamics, modal eigenproblems, hinge compliance, thermal strain correction, optical-fiber transfer, guided-wave time registration, graph observability, Kalman innovations, innovation covariance and statistical consistency, nonlinear filtering, Bayesian hypotheses, correlated uncertainty, change detection, complete-denominator fault recall, severe false-clear rates, competing-risk lifetime, fatigue propagation and noncompensatory bench-release conditions. Each plate defines its variables and units, derives or constructs a conditional model, identifies validity limits, gives a concrete blinded refutation and links to named chapters. The original source innovation, nu_k = y_k - H_k xhat_k_minus, is a residual relation for a declared observation mapping, not a guarantee of physical truth. Eighty-two chapters and 410 separately paginated investigations examine modular state identity, fold and support transitions, load redistribution, buried fatigue and joint damage, vibration and wave sensing, fiber and electrical transducers, environmental confounding, clock and calibration faults, latent-state filters, sensor network failure, uncertainty intervals, critical-recall performance, maintenance decisions and independent laboratory transfer. Two hundred individually differentiated Research Gates introduce concealed physical causes, fair mature comparators and coupled faults. Thirty-three distinguishable Phoenix Answer Embryos propose future instrument fixtures, reference transfer objects, structural stop witnesses, fault adjudicators and successor-ready evidence systems. They are proposed research capabilities, not claimed manufactured or externally validated devices. This is a hypothesis-forming, non-occupancy research work rather than an experimental safety certificate or peer-reviewed demonstration of an autonomous inhabited structure. Scientific antecedents include structural health monitoring foundations (10.1098/rsta.2006.1928), environmental variability in diagnosis (10.1098/rsta.2006.1935), long-term bridge monitoring (10.1002/1096-9845(200102)30:2<149::AID-EQE1>3.0.CO;2-Z), output-only modal methods (10.1088/0964-1726/10/3/303), nonlinear state filtering (10.1109/JPROC.2003.823141), and a specific robotic bridge inspection/fatigue digital twin study (10.1038/s44172-026-00637-0). These sources support component methods or prior experiments, not the integrated F43 concept. The author's Flagship 13 mother genealogy identifiers, 10.5281/zenodo.23318840 and 10.5281/zenodo.23318839, remain explicitly marked as metadata pending independent verification. novedades.titulo: MULTISCALE DIGITAL TWINS OF MORPHING AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES AT THE LIMIT Chinese Title / 中文書名:可變形自主車輛多尺度數位孿生極限 26/90 MULTISCALE DIGITAL TWINS OF MORPHING AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES AT THE LIMIT is a 777-page, English-language Research Working Edition in the STARLI YULI Nano Supercar Trilogy (Research Institute XXXVI, Flagship 26 of 90). It asks whether a traceable digital twin can follow actual modular-agent identities, micro-scale connection and preload states, load-bearing vehicle-body panels and bounded unoccupied chassis dynamics without converting an attractive virtual configuration into an unsupported claim of physical integrity. The core three-coupling is Digital Twins x Multiscale Physics x State Estimation. All proposed research is non-occupancy and scale-bounded; no constructed roadworthy car, occupant-protection result or highway approval is claimed. The hypothesis is falsifiable. With identical materials, sensing, computation, energy, reference metrology, analyst effort and control budgets, a frozen multiscale twin should improve out-of-sample innovation coverage without increasing preregistered physical counterexamples compared with competent conventional fleet telemetry, expert inspection and classical estimators. The sealed challenges include hidden module replacement, obsolete mesh releases, shared camera localization bias, delayed authentic sensor readings, unsupported load-bearing edges and misidentified model versions. No benefit counts if physical identity, uncertainty, load paths, calibration or independent stop authority cannot be reconstructed; failed and rejected trials remain in the denominator. Thirty mechanism-distinct mathematical plates cover Kalman innovations, normalized residual calibration, Bayesian updating, observability, covariance propagation, correlated uncertainty, geometric registration, mechanical stiffness assembly, weak modes, continuum energy, buckling, homogenization, scale-interface force balance, hybrid dynamics, actuator hysteresis, thermomechanical balance, vibration modes, time synchronization, model discrepancy, forecast coverage, complete-population yield, physical stopping, provenance chains, tail risk and conjunctive release. Each plate includes a mathematically specific derivation, units, assumptions and identifiability conditions, blinded falsification and chapter links. The source's Kalman innovation nu_k=y_k-H_k xhat_k_prior is retained as the primary inherited candidate, not treated as proof of physical truth. Eighty-two chapters develop 410 separately paginated research investigations across module evidence, panel mechanics, bounded chassis dynamics, state inference, adversarial validation and successor reproducibility. Two hundred individually specified Research Gates address hidden physical errors, honest strong-baseline contests and cross-scale interface failures. Thirty-three genuinely different Phoenix Answer Embryos propose future metrology instruments, test rigs, traceability protocols and limited validation capabilities with explicit disconfirmation and retirement tests. They are proposals for future research, not experimental achievements of this book. The methods and limitations are anchored to author-supplied Flagship 13 genealogy (10.5281/zenodo.23318840 and 10.5281/zenodo.23318839; public metadata not independently confirmed) and differentiated external precedents: robotic inspection with structural digital twins (10.1038/s44172-026-00637-0), urban transit predictive maintenance (10.1038/s41598-026-60575-x), formal digital-twin validation (10.1002/iis2.13145), force-metrology twin services (10.21014/tc6-2022.032), digital-twin prognosis (10.1016/j.cirp.2018.04.055), optical measurement uncertainty (10.3390/s21196638) and fair quantum-optimization benchmarking (10.1038/s43588-026-00991-1). None establishes the proposed integrated autonomous vehicle. The working edition is prospective and has not undergone independent peer review or physical qualification. novedades.titulo: 中文書名:自主移動城市交通—居住協同極限|53/90 English Title: AUTONOMOUS TRANSPORT-HABITAT COORDINATION IN MOBILE CITIES AT THE LIMIT AUTONOMOUS TRANSPORT-HABITAT COORDINATION IN MOBILE CITIES AT THE LIMIT is a 777-page English Research Working Edition in the STARLI YULI Nano Supercar Trilogy (Research Institute XXXVI, Flagship 53 of 90). It asks whether physically identified, uninhabited modular habitats and synthetic service traffic can coordinate relocation and travel on an independently measured tabletop road network without concealing congestion, unauthorized space occupation, structural load failure or critical utility outages. The three-way research coupling is Autonomous Transport x Habitat Layout x Urban Efficiency. Studies are limited to guarded low-speed modules, calibrated road and support test cells, isolated low-voltage loads, inert-water fixtures, synthetic trip requests and hardware-in-the-loop experiments. No public-road, human-occupancy, building-safety, evacuation or municipal permit is asserted. The preregisterable candidate is that, under matched module, material, electrical, computing, sensing, labor, road-space and intervention budgets, a frozen transport-habitat coordination policy can improve measured critical-load uptime without increasing relocation loss beyond a predefined tolerance. Independent endpoints include protected-route clearance, group-specific service reach, queue spillback, physical braking, swept-envelope intersection and full-cycle accounting. Strong comparators are a competently tuned centralized dispatcher, a stationary layout using conventional logistics, and a guarded conservative no-move policy. Blinded challenges include road closures, hidden soft-bearing tiles, biased route maps, missing synthetic demand cohorts, radio partitions, stale intersection reservations, overhanging modules, unmetered external energy and a physically unresponsive stop channel. Aborted, denied, abandoned and unfinished trials remain in the evidence denominator. Thirty distinct mathematical research plates address moving-body planar dynamics, time-evolving road occupancy, queue and congestion relations, demand-normalized access and worst-group reach, full swept-volume clearance, physical braking and tire traction, roadway pressure, intersection conflicts, protected-path cuts, utility service continuity, transient electrical balance, inert-water closure, movement work, relocation material loss, group-access disparity, equal-resource causal effects, actual stop latency, tail-risk congestion, correlated metrology uncertainty, valid-action intersections and independent refusal reproducibility. The supplied microgrid relation P_gen + P_store - P_load - P_loss = 0 is retained only as a steady-state or instantaneous auxiliary balance when stored-energy derivatives and imported support are correctly handled; it is not treated as a traffic-optimization law. Every equation has stated units, mechanisms, failure conditions and relevant chapter interfaces. Eighty-two chapters contain 410 separately paginated investigations; 200 Research Gates propose topic-specific concealed-fault tests, matched causal comparisons and coupled-system refusal challenges; and 33 named Phoenix Answer Embryos suggest distinct experimental fixtures, evidence ledgers, route witnesses and successor validation tools. All of these are prospective research designs, not reported physical test results. The book preserves explicit noncompensatory refusal when service floors, hardwired stopping, structural support, human authority, reference integrity or protected routes cannot be independently reconstructed. Shared editorial and procedural language remains an open semantic-quality issue for a later scientifically edited edition. Methodological DOI context includes network traffic flow (Daganzo 1995, 10.1016/0191-2615(94)00022-R), dynamic multiagent consensus (Ren and Beard 2005, 10.1109/TAC.2005.846556), site-specific robotic fabrication (Keating et al. 2017, 10.1126/scirobotics.aam8986), multi-agent conflict-based pathfinding (Sharon et al. 2015, 10.1016/j.artint.2014.11.006), urban water reuse network design (Calle et al. 2023, 10.1038/s41545-023-00222-4), urban transit digital-twin predictive maintenance (Alsheikhy and Shawly 2026, 10.1038/s41598-026-60575-x), and stochastic evacuation dispatch with shared autonomous vehicles (Wang and Kieu 2026, 10.1016/j.trc.2025.105437). The source works support component methods or distinct transport problems, not a complete functioning autonomous mobile city. Author-supplied Flagship 13 Zenodo ancestry identifiers (10.5281/zenodo.23318840 and 10.5281/zenodo.23318839) are recorded as metadata pending independent confirmation. novedades.titulo: DIGITAL IDENTITY AND INTERGENERATIONAL MAINTENANCE OF RECONFIGURABLE HABITATS AT THE LIMIT is a 777-page English Research Working Edition in the STARLI YULI Nano Supercar Trilogy (Research Institute XXXVI, Flagship 58 of 90). Its central question is how an autonomous reconfigurable habitat can retain a truthful, independently recoverable history when structural parts, material batches, control firmware, sensors and maintenance responsibility change across generations. The three-way coupling is Digital Identity x Structural Genealogy x Intergenerational Maintenance. The study is strictly prospective, scaled, unoccupied and non-clinical; it does not assert that an actual residence has been certified safe. The falsifiable proposal is that, with matched materials, sensing, operator time, computation and energy, a preregistered physical-digital lineage system improves genuine identity reconstruction without worsening the depth or effectiveness of safe retreat. Strong comparators include conventionally documented building maintenance, controlled strip-down requalification and a competent digital-twin inventory. Adversarial trials introduce counterfeit asset labels, unlogged repairs, swapped connectors, stale calibration, clock partitions, false histories, obsolete data schemas, physically ineffective stop commands and material fatigue. Missing genealogy or weak physical evidence requires abstention, quarantine or retirement, rather than a cosmetic digital pass. Thirty mechanism-distinct mathematical plates address identity relations, conditional entropy, graph-edge confirmation, partial event order, tamper-evident logs, mass disposition, fatigue damage, crack growth, weak stiffness modes, environmental exposure, correlated uncertainty, selective risk and coverage, physical-stop latency, compatible safety actions, replay proportions and noncompensatory acceptance logic. Each plate states the construction, units or type premises, a concrete concealed falsifier and related chapters; no plate is presented as a newly discovered natural law. Eighty-two chapter objects contain 410 separately paginated experimental investigations on material ancestry, repair and replacement custody, calibration transfer, cross-version digital twins, longitudinal load histories, authorization, retirement, privacy and founder-independent succession. Two hundred Research Gates ask distinct blind-fault, resource-matched comparator or intergenerational transfer questions, while 33 distinguishable Phoenix Answer Embryos propose future instruments and evidence interfaces with specific ways to fail. The book reports research designs, not achieved experimental outcomes; failed, refused and incomplete cases remain part of the evidence population. The research scope remains unoccupied bench coupons, guarded modular prototypes, modelled asset histories and hardware-in-the-loop exercises. Neither an authenticated digital record nor a high identity score proves structural capacity, fire safety, ventilation, water quality, rights or real-world occupancy approval. Methodological DOI ancestry includes NIST Digital Identity Guidelines (10.6028/NIST.SP.800-63-4), secure software development (10.6028/NIST.SP.800-218), security controls (10.6028/NIST.SP.800-53r5), self-deploying structures (10.1038/s44172-026-00725-1), urban-transit predictive maintenance (10.1038/s41598-026-60575-x), and morphing robots (10.1038/s41578-024-00711-z). The author-provided Flagship 13 identifiers (10.5281/zenodo.23318840; 10.5281/zenodo.23318839) are retained as metadata-unconfirmed research-lineage references, not verified supporting results. novedades.titulo: PROGRAMMABLE MANUFACTURING OF BIOMEDICAL NANOROBOTS AT THE LIMIT Programmable Materials x Micro/Nanofabrication x Biocompatibility This high-density English research monograph develops a falsification-oriented architecture for programmable manufacturing of biomedical nano- and microrobots. Its central question is not whether a visually impressive structure can be fabricated, but whether locked geometric, magnetic, elastic and interfacial designs can be reproduced in unselected lots and retain bounded function in biological fluids. The volume treats design identity, two-photon polymerization, laser writing, micromolding, magnetic anisotropy, responsive hydrogels, surface functionalization, protein-rich exposure, metrology, lot variation, digital twins, constrained AI control, mission reliability, retrieval and lifecycle as one evidence chain. It contains 30 distinct mathematical research plates, 82 chapters, 410 independently paginated section studies, 200 detailed Research Gates and 33 Phoenix Answer Embryos. Every formula is paired with units, assumptions, identifiability requirements, a blind falsification challenge and chapter interfaces. Every Research Gate specifies why the question matters, a minimum independent protocol, required evidence, competing explanations and a stop or abstention rule. DOI-linked references are used with explicit evidence boundaries: component demonstrations and reviews do not automatically validate integrated manufacturing qualification. The scientific scope is deliberately nonclinical. Fabrication precision, motion, short-term cytocompatibility or model confidence do not establish therapeutic efficacy, autonomous in-body operation, human safety, regulatory approval or reliable clearance. The proposed minimum evidence object is a traceable design-to-qualified-mission mapping that preserves failed lots, raw data, uncertainty, safe-stop behavior, retrieval and independent reconstruction.
